His military training in Eritrea comes at a sensitive time for the region, with relations between Ethiopia and Eritrea deteriorating and renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia raising fears of a wider confrontation.  The appointment could cause concern in Addis Ababa, particularly as Somalia has strengthened its engagement with Eritrea and Egypt amid longstanding disputes with Ethiopia over sovereignty, regional security and access to the Red Sea. items.title: Eritrea: U.S. Lawmaker Proposes Trade Incentives to Push Ethiopia, Eritrea Off Conflict Cliff, Toward Peace
items.description: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- US Republican Representative Jim Baird has proposed two pieces of legislation seeking to link expanded trade and economic cooperation with Ethiopia and Eritrea to progress toward lasting peace, as tensions between the neighboring countries continue to raise fears of a renewed interstate conflict.
